title: Ulyana and the Atlas
author: Emrys Hartwell
blurb: Casper Ravensworth, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
